Rubia Tinctorum.

Rubia tinctorum. Madder. N. O. Rubiaceæ. Tincture of the root.

Clinical.─Anæmia. Bones, affections of. Spleen, affections of.

Characteristics.─The bones of young animals fed on Madder become tinged red. Burnett has found Rub. t. an excellent remedy (in ten-drop doses of the Ø) in anæmia and under-nourished conditions, especially in splenic anæmia.

Relations.─Compare: Chin., Coff., Galium (bot.). In anæmia, Ferr.
